feature_schema.requests_per_window: integer, total GraphQL requests in session observation window (15 min)
feature_schema.distinct_objects_count: integer, count of unique resource object IDs requested in the window
feature_schema.requests_per_minute: float, average request throughput per minute (requests_per_window / 15.0)
feature_schema.repeated_target_count: integer, count of requests targeting previously accessed IDs in session
feature_schema.recent_denials_count: integer, authorization denials (403 Forbidden) logged in observation window
feature_schema.cross_owner_attempts_count: integer, requests targeting resources owned by other principals
feature_schema.nested_relationship_count: integer, queries requesting nested relationship selections (e.g., children)
feature_schema.max_query_depth: integer, maximum GraphQL AST selection depth observed in session
feature_schema.enumeration_score: float [0.0, 1.0], consecutive/incremental object ID traversal pattern score
feature_schema.request_burst_rate: float, peak request throughput observed in any 60-second window (req/min)
